title: Wellbeing check-in
intro: Eight questions about how you have been feeling over the past two weeks. This is not a validated clinical instrument. Your answers are not stored and are never shared with your employer.

instrument.name: NestSelf wellbeing check-in (not a validated clinical instrument)
instrument.licence: NestSelf-authored instrument. The source URL is background reading on workplace mental health from WHO, not a licence reference.

questions.text: I have had enough energy to get through the day
I have felt in a good mood
I have felt connected to the people around me
I have been able to focus on what I was doing
I have enjoyed my daily activities
I have felt free from excessive worry
I have felt positive about what lies ahead

bands.title: Low right now
bands.body: Your responses suggest your wellbeing has been low over the past two weeks. Support is available and can help.
bands.nextStep: Consider speaking with a psychologist through your employer's programme. Your employer never learns who used NestSelf or what was discussed.

bands.title: Mixed
bands.body: Your responses suggest a mixed picture. Some areas are going well while others could use attention.
bands.nextStep: Explore our wellbeing articles and tools, or consider a confidential conversation with a psychologist through your employer's programme.

bands.title: Steady
bands.body: Your responses suggest your wellbeing has been steady over the past two weeks. Keeping up healthy routines can help you stay on track.
bands.nextStep: Explore our wellbeing articles and tools for ideas on maintaining balance.

disclaimer: This tool is not a medical device and does not provide a diagnosis. It is for informational purposes only. For a clinical evaluation, talk to a licensed professional. If you are in crisis, call the emergency number.

crisis.title: Need immediate help?
crisis.body: If you or someone you know is in immediate danger, call the emergency number now.
